t: r/ThriftStoreHauls on Reddit: I found this couch on Facebook for $25! The tag says it’s from Ross Furniture Company in Statesville, North Carolina. Any info would be appreciated.
s: February 16, 2017 - Ross furniture was mid to lower tier american furniture company. They formed in the 1940’s I think and dissolved sometime in the 70’s. Their stuff isn’t particularly valuable or collectible, but it is likely well made compared to todays standards and seems to be a beautiful and functional piece. Several of my family members worked in furniture when the company existed, but they all worked for Thonet’s Statesville location which was better known and more respected.
